record.NAME: k_ced_object_acceleration_weight
record.DESCRIPTION: Weights the influence of the objects acceleration on the prediction and TTC calculation.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_heading_predicted_weight
record.DESCRIPTION: Weights the predicted heading that will be used for objects without path match. This parameter can control the influence of the object heading on the predicted object and can be used as a temporary fix to ignore an inaccurate tracker heading for the predicted object.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_existence_probability_min
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum existence probability of the target object.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_heading_abs_angle_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum allowed absolute heading angle of the target object.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_long_vel_rel_min
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum approaching longitudinal relative velocity of the target object.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_long_vel_min
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum longitudinal target object velocity.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_lat_vel_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum lateral target velocity.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_max_width_increase_factor_with_path_match
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximal width increase factor of the predicted object for objects with path match. The applied width increase factor will be at the maximal value at the end of the funnel zone and will decrease linearly based on the distance to the crash line. Thus setting the value to 0.0f deactivates the width increase completely.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_max_width_increase_factor_without_path_match
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximal width increase factor of the predicted object for objects without path match. The applied width increase factor will be at the maximal value at the end of the funnel zone and will decrease linearly based on the distance to the crash line. Thus setting the value to 0.0f deactivates the width increase completely.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_heading_exp_moving_average_alpha
record.DESCRIPTION: Set alpha value for exponential moving average filter for object heading. Higher alpha means more weight for current values.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_ftm_existence_probability_min
record.DESCRIPTION: The minimum existence probability of the target object coming from front direction.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_ftm_heading_abs_angle_min
record.DESCRIPTION: The minimum allowed absolute heading angle of the front coming target.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_ftm_long_vel_rel_min
record.DESCRIPTION: The minimum relative longitudinal velocity of the front oncoming target object.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_ftm_long_vel_min
record.DESCRIPTION: The minimum longitudinal front approaching target object velocity.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_ftm_lat_vel_max
record.DESCRIPTION: The maximum lateral front oncoming target object velocity.

record.NAME: k_ced_first_warning_ttc_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: This parameter defines the TTC threshold for the first warning level. [FRONT REAR]

record.NAME: k_ced_second_warning_ttc_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: This parameter defines the TTC threshold for the second warning level if it is enabled. [FRONT REAR]

record.NAME: k_ced_third_warning_ttc_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: This parameter defines the TTC threshold for the third warning level if it is enabled. [FRONT REAR]

record.NAME: k_ced_second_warning_pred_lat_dist_max
record.DESCRIPTION: This parameter defines the maximum lateral object distance threshold for the second warning level. It shall not be less than k_ced_collision_zone_width.

record.NAME: k_ced_third_warning_pred_lat_dist_max
record.DESCRIPTION: This parameter defines the maximum lateral object distance threshold for the third warning level. It shall not be less than k_ced_collision_zone_width.

record.NAME: k_ced_alert_ttp_min
record.DESCRIPTION: Only objects with a time-to-pass equal or above this value can trigger a warning. Also alert holding can be deactived for objects with a TTP below this value using k_ced_f_suppress_alert_holding_for_obj_below_min_ttp.

record.NAME: k_ced_ego_abs_speed_max
record.DESCRIPTION: CED will only work for absolute ego speed values equal or below this value.

record.NAME: k_ced_crash_line_host_length_percentage
record.DESCRIPTION: The crash line is set as a percentage of the vehicle length. (0.0 = front bumper, 1.0 = rear bumper). Element [0] refers to objects coming from front, [1] from rear

record.NAME: k_ced_object_width_safety_margin_for_active_alert
record.DESCRIPTION: This value is added to the width of the predicted object, for any object that was alerted in the previous cycle.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_width_safety_margin_for_critical_path_match
record.DESCRIPTION: This value is added to the width of the predicted object, for any object that is matched to the same path as any object with an active alert.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_min_dist_to_crash_line_for_path_match
record.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the minimum absolute distance of the object to the crash line to activate path matching functionality. Objects that are closer will be predicted using their heading.

record.NAME: k_ced_offset_to_path_weight
record.DESCRIPTION: Weight to change the influence of the path offset for the predicted object at the crash line.

record.NAME: k_ced_collision_zone_width
record.DESCRIPTION: Sets the width of the collision zone next to the vehicle. Should be set to door length plus safety margin.

record.NAME: k_ced_funnel_zone_length
record.DESCRIPTION: Sets the length of the funnel zones.

record.NAME: k_ced_funnel_zone_width
record.DESCRIPTION: Sets the width of the funnel zones on the side furthest away from the ego.

record.NAME: k_ced_alert_qualifying_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of qualifying cycles for objects that are not classified as slow objects. See also k_ced_alert_qualifying_cycles_slow_objects and k_ced_slow_objects_long_vel_max.

record.NAME: k_ced_alert_qualifying_cycles_slow_objects
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of qualifying cycles for objects that are classified as slow objects. See also k_ced_alert_qualifying_cycles and k_ced_slow_objects_long_vel_max.

record.NAME: k_ced_slow_objects_long_vel_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximal longitudinal object velocity of an object to be classified as slow object regarding alert qualifying. Use 0.0f to disable different handling of slow objects.

record.NAME: k_ced_alert_holding_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of holding cycles for alert.

record.NAME: k_ced_allow_opposite_side_alerts
record.DESCRIPTION: Objects on one ego side are allowed to give an alert for the opposite side (0: not allowed, 1: only allowed if object is matched to a path, 2: allowed for all objects).

record.NAME: k_ced_ego_lane_width
record.DESCRIPTION: Sets the virtual width of the ego lane. Is used for classifying objects ego side as EGO_LANE and alert side as INTERSEC_BOTH_SIDES.

record.NAME: k_ced_ego_lane_parking_range
record.DESCRIPTION: Sets the range for a parking scenario of an approaching object. Is used for suppression of objects moving on the ego lane when those are parking.

record.NAME: k_ced_ego_lane_parking_maneuver_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: Sets the speed for a parking scenario of an approaching object. Is used for suppression of objects moving on the ego lane when those are parking.

record.NAME: k_ced_alert_holding_obj_abs_heading_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum allowed absolute heading angle of the target object for alert holding logic.

record.NAME: k_ced_alert_holding_obj_long_vel_min
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum approaching longitudinal relative velocity of the target object for alert holding logic.

record.NAME: k_ced_suppress_pt_heading_diff_ced_alert_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum allowed heading difference of the target object and its nearest path for alerting the object.

record.NAME: k_ced_suppress_range_to_nearest_path_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum allowed range between the target object and its nearest path segment.

record.NAME: k_ced_suppress_alert_object_age_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Based on the nearest path a young object causing an alert can be suppressed. In case that nearest path suppression shall not be used, this calibration can be set to zero.

record.NAME: k_ced_min_cycles_for_path_match_for_no_suppress
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum amount of consecutive cycles a new object needs to be matched to a path so that suppression is not applied to it.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_age_min
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimal tracker age of object needed to be relevant.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_ftm_age_min
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimal tracker age of object coming from front direction needed to be relevant.

record.NAME: k_ced_f_enable_heading_exp_moving_average
record.DESCRIPTION: Indicates if the exponential moving average function for the object heading is enabled.

record.NAME: k_ced_f_second_warning_level_enable
record.DESCRIPTION: Enable the second warning level.

record.NAME: k_ced_f_third_warning_level_enable
record.DESCRIPTION: Enable the third warning level.

record.NAME: k_ced_f_suppress_alert_holding_for_uncritical_objects
record.DESCRIPTION: If enabled alert holding on objects with heading or long velocity out of allowed range is suppressed.

record.NAME: k_ced_f_suppress_alert_holding_for_obj_below_min_ttp
record.DESCRIPTION: If enabled alert holding on objects with a TTP below k_ced_alert_ttp_min is suppressed.

record.NAME: k_ced_f_path_tracking_enable
record.DESCRIPTION: Enable use of path tracking information.

record.NAME: k_ced_f_handle_both_side_alerts_as_object_side
record.DESCRIPTION: Objects that alert both sides are restricted to only alert their current side.

record.NAME: k_ced_f_allow_ego_lane_alerts
record.DESCRIPTION: Objects that are laterally in the ego lane (defined by k_ced_ego_lane_width) are allowed to give alerts.

record.NAME: k_ced_f_use_only_mature_paths
record.DESCRIPTION: Pathtracking data can be used only if matched path is mature.

record.NAME: k_ced_f_allow_coasted_object_alerts
record.DESCRIPTION: Objects that are coasting are allowed to give alerts.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_long_vel_rel_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum approaching longitudinal relative velocity of the target object.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_ftm_long_vel_rel_max
record.DESCRIPTION: The maximum relative longitudinal velocity of the front oncoming target object.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_vel_max
record.DESCRIPTION: The maximum speed of the target object.

record.NAME: k_ced_f_choose_ref_point_funnel_check
record.DESCRIPTION: Set refference point in funnel occupance check. (0: deafult, 1: front bumper, 2: nearest corner)

record.NAME: k_ced_f_adapt_heading_ego_lane
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag whether heading angle should be zeroed

record.NAME: k_ced_slight_turn_lat_vel_table
record.DESCRIPTION: Table with the lateral velocity thresholds for the slight turn logic. If y-speed is below 1st value, sets heading to 0; if over 2nd value, keep initial heading; if between thresholds, heading grows linearly from zero to initial value

record.NAME: k_ced_slight_turn_position_limits
record.DESCRIPTION: Longitudinal (first) and lateral (second) thresholds for object distance in slight turn logic. By default set to invalid ced distance

record.NAME: k_ced_f_object_lat_on_one_side_of_border
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag to check if the alert should be suppressed due to the location of the object. Only if the reference point (depend on FOV in which it is located) is on the correct side of the specified line(k_ced_lat_pos_of_border), alert shall be triggered

record.NAME: k_ced_lat_pos_of_border
record.DESCRIPTION: Lateral position of line indicating the longitudinal boundary along which we verify the alert. For RL FOV: Calculated from the left side of the host, For RR FOV: Calculated from the right side of the host

record.NAME: k_ced_lat_pos_shift_enable
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag enabling logic for shifting lateral position

record.NAME: k_ced_lat_pos_max_shift
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximal value of the lateral position shift, in direction away from ego

record.NAME: k_ced_lat_pos_shift_long_dist_thresholds
record.DESCRIPTION: Longitudinal distance thresholds for lateral shift calculations. Full shift is applied for objects located farer than 2nd threshold, no shift below 1st threshold, linear slope between them

record.NAME: k_ced_lat_pos_shift_lat_dist_thresholds
record.DESCRIPTION: Lateral distance thresholds for lateral shift calculations. Full shift is applied for objects located farer than 2nd threshold, no shift below 1st threshold, linear slope between them

record.NAME: k_bmw_ced_speed_max_hysteresis
record.DESCRIPTION: CED will only work for absolute ego speed values equal or below this value of hysteresis for activation speed.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_predicted_max_width_slope_reduce_factor
record.DESCRIPTION: Factor reducing the slope of predicted width.

record.NAME: k_ced_object_predicted_max_width_slope_offset
record.DESCRIPTION: Offset added to object predicted width. It compensates error related to the slope reduce factor.

record.NAME: k_ced_lat_pos_shift_width_thresh
record.DESCRIPTION: If object width is equal or greater than this threshold, the lateral position shift will be applied.

record.NAME: k_ced_warning_pred_lat_dist_max_histeresis
record.DESCRIPTION: This parameter defines the hystereis of maximum lateral object distance threshold for the ALL warning levels.
